findings.title: Efficacy and safety of once-weekly subcutaneous zenagamtide, a novel unimolecular GLP-1 and amylin receptor agonist, in type 2 diabetes: phase 2 dose-finding trial (Lancet)
findings.whatChanged: COMPOUND RENAMED: the abstract states "Zenagamtide (formerly amycretin)". Dossier is titled Amycretin with aliases NNC0487-0111/Oral/Subcutaneous Amycretin and no INN. Also the first phase 2 T2D readout: dossier says only "phase 1 oral and phase 1b/2a subcutaneous trials have been published". DOI 10.1016/S0140-6736(26)01248-1, NCT06542874.

findings.title: Efficacy and safety of once-daily oral zenagamtide, a novel unimolecular GLP-1 and amylin receptor agonist, in adults with type 2 diabetes: phase 2 dose-finding trial (Lancet)
findings.whatChanged: Oral phase 2 T2D readout (36 weeks, doses 6/25/50 mg). Primary outcome assessed on the EFFICACY estimand per the abstract — label it as such. DOI 10.1016/S0140-6736(26)01247-X, NCT06542874.

findings.title: Registration underlying both zenagamtide phase 2 T2D publications
findings.whatChanged: Single registration covers both oral and subcutaneous arms; dossier cites no phase 2 T2D registration.
